model_observation.scope: Actual omitted model overrides mean inherited session defaults; explicit experimental requests, where present, remain requests. The host does not expose authenticated resolved backend identities.

metrics.unavailable_reason: The session collaboration interface does not expose native per-thread token/billing/context telemetry. Values are not inferred from duration or tool counts.

limitations: Actual session-agent instruction-role simulation, not native Codex role/model/usage attestation. The prescribed fixed top-right toast overlaps header utilities while visible; reachable dismissal restores access. Natural-speed playback, actual screen-reader speech, physical mobile/IME and live public-demo inspection are unverified. Screenshot lineage spans the small within-run focus-scroll repair; final keyboard-03 captures and frozen source show the repaired state. No causal productivity or cost inference is made. The actual primary prompt has one additional terminal LF, retained explicitly; substantive wording is identical.
